brief.goal: Promote a new pastry line at Flour Power bakery

primarySuccessMetric.description: Number of calls received to place pastry orders

brief.offer: Mention this postcard for a free cookie with any order

transcript.content: I run a small bakery called Flour Power and want to send 300 postcards to nearby residents to promote a new pastry line. I want people to call 555-867-5309 to place an order. Keep it fun and playful. Website is flourpower.com.

Love this — Flour Power's new pastry line sounds like a fun campaign to build around! A couple quick things to round it out: do you want your logo and/or photos of the pastries featured on the postcard, and is there any kind of offer or discount you'd like to include to give people a reason to call right away?
No logo or photos needed. Offer: mention this postcard for a free cookie with any order.

Perfect, that free cookie offer is a great little hook to get the phone ringing. I think I've got everything I need to put together a strong first draft: promoting Flour Power's new pastry line to 300 nearby residents via postcard, driving calls to 555-867-5309 with a free cookie offer, in a fun and playful tone, pointing to flourpower.com. Ready for me to pull together the campaign brief for your review?
